items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: I always remember, Big Bill Brownzy and Wild Bill Davison and Art Hodes going out and getting a fifth of booze... But he was a real warm character

ctx.x: He worked also as an act, and that's where Big Bill -- I always remember, Big Bill Brownzy and Wild Bill Davison and Art Hodes going out and getting a fifth of booze, of some kind of whiskey. And Wild Bill had a drink and then Big Bill grabbed the bottle. And when he got through putting it down behind -- from his mouth, I could see where the bottom of his fist was, the whiskey was below that bottom. And I says, no more, I ain't going in with him in no bottles no more.

But he was a real warm character, and he was a great player.
